Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Does the untap effect of Shell Game take place before or after the
effects of a referendum called by the Blood Brother who played Shell
Game (assuming that referendum passes)?

I'm not sure - the action is successful once it reaches the
referendum, but the action hasn't reached resolution until after the
referendum. It seems to me that Shell Game should untap your guys
after blocks are declined but before the referendum, but I have a
feeling that LSJ's going to say otherwise.

John Eno
